items.title: Houston Person Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Dinah Washington, Buddy Johnson, Stan Kenton. I was in the south. Yeah, Stan Kenton, Dizzy Gillespie. Just about everybody — Lester Young — they were all on 78’s.

ctx.x: Who did you buy when you were young, that you were listening to, and were they on 78’s at that time?
Oh yeah, yeah. Dinah Washington, Buddy Johnson, Stan Kenton. I was in the south. Yeah, Stan Kenton, Dizzy Gillespie. Just about everybody — Lester Young — they were all on 78’s. And then the LP came.
Who in particular on tenor did you feel that you might have been influenced by?
